description: Marigold normals LCM from ETH Zurich (PRS): surface normals from one image in one diffusion step on a Stable Diffusion UNet. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Details
  • Paper: Marigold: Affordable Adaptation of Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Image Analysis, arXiv, 2025-05-14
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers at 086bf95
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/prs-eth/Marigold (PyTorch): The prs-eth/marigold-normals-lcm-v0-1 weights are published as a diffusers pipeline, so fastforks follows the diffusers implementation rather than the authors' own repository.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE, LICENSE-huggingface
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/prs-eth/marigold-normals-lcm-v0-1/blob/28214f06633a6a73088b569d1d068c3e48ea7902/README.md (license: apache-2.0)
  • Training data: Stable Diffusion 2 (LAION-5B subsets) fine-tuned on the synthetic Hypersim, Virtual KITTI 2 and other synthetic datasets per the Marigold paper (arXiv 2505.09358), then LCM-distilled
  • Options: steps = 1 (1 to 50), long_side = 768 (>= 0; also processing_res), seed = 2024
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: marigold-normals-lcm-v0-1
  • Outputs: normals; kind: none
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): marigold-normals-lcm-v0-1 3000x4000 (3.0 GiB peak allocated, 3.8 reserved)
  • marigold-normals-lcm-v0-1 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 64 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 182 s (ONNX + engine).
  • marigold-normals-lcm-v0-1 original 994x1482: the authors' float16 model option; diffusers v0.41.0 MarigoldNormalsPipeline, 1 LCM step, CPU generator seed 2024
  • marigold-normals-lcm-v0-1 load / first call: original 6.02 s / 2.856 s, portable 4.11 s / 0.617 s, kernels 8.22 s / 0.468 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

AbsRel / delta1 after a least-squares scale + shift fit (in disparity space for inverse-depth models), mean over images. Normals: angle to the ground-truth normal over the pixels with ground truth (Marigold's evaluation sets), mean over images. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.00052 and p99 <= 0.0022 (absolute error of the output normals).

Limitations

  • Normals only: no depth.
  • Diffusion model: the seeded noise comes from a CPU generator and differs from a CUDA generator's for the same seed.
  • A traced or exported module reuses the noise of its traced shape.
